name: Green curry with shrimp
notes: Rachel Cooks Thai (4 bowls: 1 cup coconut milk, 2 tbsp paste, 1/2 cup meat, 1 to 2 cups water, 2 cups vegetables, 1 tsp fish sauce, 1/2 tsp sugar) is thin; restaurants and Eating Thai Food (2 to 3 cups of coconut cream for 8) are richer. Per bowl 90 g of coconut milk and 14 g of paste, the middle of the two; 80 g of water; protein is the cooked weight, 70 g; herbs under 5 g and kaffir lime leaves are left out.
